purpose: Repo-owned test additions for this round. None of these files exist in the pristine upstream modules; they are additions, not modifications.
rule_checked: goals/T08.md line 11 requires blank / numeric / time SEARCH, NULL, sorting-total, mask and token anti-tampering coverage; line 12 requires an executable-init smoke test and forbids the old pagination package in the run/test graphs.
no_upstream_test_was_excluded: Every upstream _test.go that was taken over stayed in place with its original build constraints. tools/migration/migrate_imports.go equiv reported import-only equivalence (equiv_exit = 0) for all 19 rewritten files in T08-provenance.json, and the guard reported pass=true for 276 consumer files in migration/preflight/T08-guard-import-only.json, so no exclusion tag, skip or renamed expectation was introduced anywhere in this round.

covers: pagination/v1/pagination.proto is registered exactly once in the process and the registered descriptor is the one behind the imported Go types (protobuf-go refuses a second registration, so a duplicate source fails here instead of silently)
the registered go_package is go-wind-admin/pkg/localdeps/go-crud/api/gen/go/pagination/v1 and no import path of the file points at github.com/tx7do

the frozen protocol contract: 12 messages / 3 top-level enums / 5 imports, every PagingRequest field name, number, kind, json_name, oneof, cardinality and option-extension count, plus the full Operator / DatePart / ExprType / Sorting.Direction value tables

the pagination filter chain resolves its codec from pkg/localdeps/go-wind-plugins/encoding (the init registration of pkg/localdeps/go-wind-plugins/encoding/json), round-trips through it, and still rejects malformed JSON instead of silently producing no condition
SEARCH survives localization both as the enum value and in the operator string table, and a blank-value SEARCH query converts into one SEARCH condition

token anti-tampering at the Repository layer: a cursor signed with the global secret is decoded into an id > ? predicate, while a flipped signature, an extended payload, a foreign secret, a legacy unsigned cursor and an empty token all fail closed to a page-size-only query

the secret writer and reader are one process instance: SetTokenSecret/EncodeAndSign in pkg/localdeps/go-crud/pagination are what the entgo TokenPaginator reads, so a split runtime would turn the first test red
unsigned mode keeps working when no secret is configured (no silent behaviour change for deployments that do not set one)
